name: Hougamigum
source:
Hougamigum is an SFW furry visual novel about 4 girls who are each dumb in their unique ways. Living on an island nation hidden from the rest of the world, the 4 girls are menaces to society, always wreaking havoc wherever they go. The girls and the other residents of Hougamigum  must learn to work together and stop fighting.

[From [url=https://hougamigum.itch.io/hougamigum]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Hougamigum是一部SFW毛茸茸的视觉小说，讲述了4个女孩的故事，她们每个人都以独特的方式愚蠢。这四个女孩生活在一个与世隔绝的岛国，她们对社会构成威胁，无论走到哪里都会造成严重破坏。女孩们和胡加米古姆的其他居民必须学会共同努力，停止争斗。

[来自[url=https://hougamigum.itch.io/hougamigum]itch.io[/url]]
